change: Add a Tera-hold prior: penalize Tera before ~turn 10 / before the opponent has Teraed unless it changes a KO or survival threshold this turn (e.g., value bonus for 'opponent Tera spent, ours available').
expected_effect: Later median Tera turn (toward top-player ~turn 20) and higher win rate, especially in endgames.
metric: Win rate over ≥1000 fixed-seed self-play games vs baseline; median Tera turn; % games where we Tera second.

change: Raise the opponent-switch probability in the opponent model from a near-zero/attack-only prior to ~0.25 overall (~0.32 on turn 1), conditioned on how threatened their active is.
expected_effect: Better punish-switch move choice (coverage/hazards/status on predicted switch-ins); fewer wasted super-effective hits into switch-ins.
metric: Win rate vs baseline; % of our attacks that hit a different mon than targeted with low effectiveness; damage dealt per turn.

change: Calibrate our own hard-switch rate toward top-player levels (target ~20–25% of decisions, tapering by phase) via a switch-value bonus when the switch-in takes the expected hit at ≤ X% and threatens back.
expected_effect: Fewer mons lost from high HP; higher win rate.
metric: Hard-switch rate per phase; % of our faints that start the turn at ≥80% HP (top players ~19%, low ~27%); win rate.

change: Gate setup moves: disallow boosting before turn 4 or before ≥3 opponent mons are revealed unless no revealed/inferred opposing mon can punish (calc-based check).
expected_effect: Fewer failed sweeps; setup usage shifts later (top players ~6% of setup in turns 1–3).
metric: Share of setup moves used turns 1–3; setup-sweeper survival rate after boosting; win rate.

change: Use the pkmn randbats stats JSON as the Bayesian prior and add hard-evidence filters (status move ⇒ no AV; hazard damage ⇒ no Boots; priority ⇒ no Scarf; 4 same-category attacks ⇒ Choice; hazard revealed ⇒ no setup on that mon).
expected_effect: More accurate opponent set prediction and fewer surprise KOs.
metric: Log-likelihood / top-1 accuracy of predicted moves & items vs revealed sets at game end; win rate.

change: Add team-generation constraint inference for unrevealed opponent slots (≤2 per type, ≤3 weak to a type, ≤1 shared 4x weakness, ≤1 level 100, ≤1 Tera Blast user, ≤1 SR/Web/TSpikes/remover).
expected_effect: Better sampling of hidden mons in determinized search; better 'hide my win condition' decisions.
metric: Accuracy of predicted unrevealed species types at game end; win rate in games where ≥2 opponent mons stay hidden past turn 15.

change: Add a hazard-context term: value hazards by (number of opponent mons without Boots/removal expected) and penalize setting hazards when the opponent's active can set up or KO the setter.
expected_effect: Hazards set more often in safe spots; fewer setters lost for nothing.
metric: Hazard turns used; setter survival; opponent hazard damage taken per game; win rate.

change: Win-condition preservation bonus: identify our likely wincon(s) at turn 1 (setup, Scarf, priority, fastest, unresisted STAB) and add eval weight to keeping them healthy and unrevealed until opponent checks are weakened.
metric: Win rate; average HP of designated wincon at its first appearance; turn of first reveal of wincon.

change: Information-hiding term: small penalty for revealing an extra unrevealed mon when an already-revealed mon is an acceptable choice.
expected_effect: Opponent has less information mid-game; marginal win-rate gain.
metric: Average number of our mons revealed by turn 10 vs opponent's; win rate.

change: Sack-choice heuristic: when no safe switch exists, prefer sacking the mon with the lowest remaining 'role value' (job done, low HP, statused, outclassed) to get a free switch for the wincon.
expected_effect: Fewer wasted healthy mons; better tempo.
metric: Rate of faints from ≥80% HP; win rate.

change: Endgame mode: when ≤3 mons per side, increase search depth/time and include PP tracking and priority/Tera branches.
expected_effect: Fewer endgame chokes; better PP-stall handling (a known bot weakness).
metric: Win rate in games reaching ≤3v3; win rate in games longer than 40 turns.

change: Opponent Tera anticipation: when the opponent stays in or brings a mon that is a non-answer to our boosted threat, raise probability of their defensive Tera and pick moves robust to their role's Tera list.
expected_effect: Fewer sweeps stopped by surprise Tera.
metric: % of our setup sweeps ending in ≥2 KOs; damage efficiency on Tera turns.

change: Level-aware threat assessment: compute exact stats from level for all speed/damage judgements and drop any tier-based heuristics in the LLM prompt.
metric: Outspeed prediction accuracy (predicted vs observed move order); KO-prediction accuracy.

change: Pivot preference: when expected values are close, prefer U-turn/Volt Switch/Flip Turn over a direct attack early in the game (except into likely immunities).
expected_effect: More information gained early; better switch-ins.
metric: Number of opponent mons revealed by turn 8; pivot usage share (top ~4% of moves vs low ~3%); win rate.

change: LLM strategist role limited to tie-breaking and post-game review, never sole decider; compare to LLM-overrides-search.
metric: Win rate head-to-head over ≥1000 games; LLM call latency and timeouts.

change: Treat negative evidence from opponent switch behavior (sacking into or repeatedly sending non-answers to one of our mons) as a signal that the opponent lacks a check; increase that mon's wincon score.
metric: Win rate; correlation between flagged mon and the mon that gets the most KOs.
